THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS1_WATCHER.0-0r.anc: Who are you? You are not in my blueprints.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS1_WATCHER.0-1r.cha:
I have climbed this Spire before.
A different Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS1_WATCHER.0-2r.anc:
Impossible. You do not truly exist.
Someone [jitter]spooned[/jitter] you in.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS1_WATCHER.1-0r.anc:
A borrowed soul from a borrowed tower.
You are a rumor, nothing more.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.STS1_WATCHER.1-1r.cha: Then a rumor will end you.
